description: This file defines the AuthTokenGenerator class responsible for generating AWS RDS authentication tokens for IAM authentication. It handles credential provision, token creation with URL signing, and includes methods for creating signed URLs for database login.

classes.name: AuthTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating AWS RDS IAM authentication tokens, supporting credential provisioning and URL signing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AuthTokenGenerator with credentials or a credential provider.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Generates a signed authentication token for RDS database login using specified endpoint, region, username, and token lifetime.
